description: Use when someone wants to adopt a dog from a shelter in Germany, e.g. 'adopt a dog in Berlin' or 'Hund aus dem Tierheim adoptieren Bayern'. Searches dogs currently listed for adoption by German shelters on HonestDog, by breed text, size, gender, or Bundesland. Adoption happens with the shelter via the linked pages. / Durchsucht die aktuell zur Adoption gelisteten Tierheimhunde nach Rasse, Größe, Geschlecht oder Bundesland.

breed_text.description: Breed text as listed by the shelter (substring match)

name: search_shelter_dogs
title: Search adoptable shelter dogs
